name: SikaRapid®-4
summary: SikaRapid®-4 is a set accelerator for concrete and mortar containing added chloride.
metaDescription: SikaRapid®-4 is a set accelerator for concrete and mortar containing added chloride.
attributes: Can be used as an accelerator or in combination with a superplasticiser.
usage: SikaRapid®-4 is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where accelerated setting times are required.  As a result, SikaRapid®-4 allows:
Improved early strength of premixed concrete.
advantages: Can be used as an accelerator or in combination with a superplasticiser.
packaging: Bulk deliveries 1000 litre IBC 205 litre drum 10 litre container

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: SikaRapid®-4 meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Accelerator (Ac).

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight, shelf life is at least one (1) year.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from direct sunlight.

items.label: Dispensing
items.text: SikaRapid®-4 is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid®-4 may also be added into the premix truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
SikaRapid®-4 can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika plasticiser or superplasticiser. It is beneficial to add the SikaRapid®-4 with the initial mixing water before the addition of superplasticiser to enhance strength development. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum combination.
Do not use SikaRapid®-4 in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: Dosage is 400ml - 2000ml/100 kg of total cementitious material. Exact dosage rate should be determined by site trials.
